ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course includes online synchronous class sessions. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed internet. Wireless Internet is not recommended. This section is for intended only for students who are admitted to the CPSC MS Online Program.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC or MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $325.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
